name: Beast Feast
description: The Plover Caves — a warren of tunnels and caverns where most residents live in camps and small, permanent cabins carved straight out of the rock, and daily life runs on a communal culture of bartering and trade. Every major cavern hosts a Berry's, the ubiquitous chain of small restaurants serving the catch of the day — part meal, part social hub, part early-warning system for whatever dangerous beast is prowling the tunnels this week. The Investigators are everyday heroes from the village: hunters, cooks, and haulers who venture out on long, risky expeditions to put food on the table, building a shared cookbook of what they've caught (and survived) along the way.
